name: Sales Pitch Workshop
goal: Sharpen the sales pitch deck: opening hook, value framing, three customer stories, objection handling, and a clear ask. Produce a one-page pitch summary and a list of anticipated questions with crisp answers.
description: A sales lead drives the narrative and owns the customer voice. A writer tightens every slide and turns rough notes into pitch-ready prose. An analyst pulls comparable numbers and pressure-tests every claim before it hits the deck.
